Name: Brayflox Farmhouse (CP and AT)
Author: madishartte
Description:
It's a cute little farmhouse in a painterly style. If enough people like this I'll make the other buildings!* Comes in seasonal variations, as well as a more muted palette that works well with VPR. You can toggle between VPR and Vanilla in Config settings. Also includes a Vanilla, no-decor option for those who want to decorate the porch how they like!

Alternative Textures version is included in optional files.
